reading: Hollywood actor Matthew Rhys made history at the Emmys.
He won two lead acting prizes in one night.
He won for best lead actor in a limited series and for a comedy.
At the start of his career, Rhys considered joining the British Army.
He later received a rejection letter and could not join the army.
Rhys speaks Welsh to his son Sam at home in New York.
He also voices Han Solo in a new Welsh language adaptation of Star Wars.

vocabulary.definition: A person who performs in movies, TV shows, or plays.
When something very important happens for the first time or is remembered for a long time.
Awards or things you win in a competition or for doing something very well.
Thought about something carefully before making a decision.
Becoming a member of a group, organization, or team.
Uses words to talk in a language.
Provides the sound of a character for a movie, show, or game.

entries.ja: 映画、テレビ番組、または演劇に出演する人。

entries.pt-BR: Quando algo muito importante acontece pela primeira vez ou é lembrado por muito tempo.

entries.de: Wenn etwas sehr Wichtiges zum ersten Mal geschieht oder lange Zeit in Erinnerung bleibt.

entries.ja: 競技会で、または何かを非常にうまくやったことで獲得する賞や物。
entries.ko: 대회에서 또는 무언가를 아주 잘해서 얻는 상이나 물건.

entries.de: Auszeichnungen oder Dinge, die man in einem Wettbewerb oder dafür gewinnt, dass man etwas sehr gut gemacht hat.

entries.zh-Hans: 在做决定之前仔细思考某事。

entries.pt-BR: Pensar cuidadosamente sobre algo antes de tomar uma decisão.
entries.fr: A réfléchi à quelque chose attentivement avant de prendre une décision.
entries.de: Hat sorgfältig über etwas nachgedacht, bevor eine Entscheidung getroffen wurde.

entries.pt-BR: Tornar-se membro de um grupo, organização ou equipe.

entries.de: Mitglied einer Gruppe, Organisation oder eines Teams werden.

entries.pt-BR: Usar palavras para se comunicar em um idioma.

entries.zh-Hans: 为电影、节目或游戏中的角色配音。

entries.pt-BR: Fornecer a voz de um personagem para um filme, programa ou jogo.
